rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Preparation pair: oxidation of 1°/2° alcohols; Rosenmund (acyl chloride → aldehyde, poisoned Pd/BaSO4); acyl chloride + dialkylcadmium → ketone — the selectivity of each reagent is the mark.  ·  Trick 2: Nucleophilic addition order: HCHO > aldehydes > ketones (steric + electronic) — reactivity falls with alkyl substitution.
